title: Latvia's election system check finds flaws
summary_full: In the run-up to the Saeima elections, polling station staff are testing the electoral systems. Cybersecurity authorities have carried out intensive checks and identified several vulnerabilities, one of which was reportedly critical, Latvian Radio reported on August 27.
